card.name: Study-method words after a or the
card.fires_on: The word right after "a", "the" or "any one" in clinical-trial methods text, such as "time" in "at the time of" or "a time-to-first-event", and "blinded" before "adjudication committee".

modes.label: time in trial phrases
modes.description: The word "time" after "a", "the" or "any one" in measurement or analysis phrases.
modes.example: In a<< time>>-to-first-event analysis the risk of hospital

modes.label: blinded committee
modes.description: The word "blinded" before an adjudication committee in a safety endpoint description.
modes.example: A<< blinded>> adjudication committee determined whether events were asthma

modes.label: named assessment scale
modes.description: The word "Modified" starting the name of a rating scale.
modes.example: based on the<< Modified>> Observer's Assessment of Alertness/Sed

card.writes: It seems to suppress "baseline" as the next word; the promoted tokens show no clear theme.
card.plain: It marks the descriptive word in trial-method phrases like "at the time of" or "a blinded committee".
